purpose: 以独立保存的旧检查点复核原始字节归档，观察完整决策及不同非法字节的真实输出。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 2 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-�", "ledger-\xfe", "ledger-\xff"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-�", "ledger-\xfe", "ledger-\xff"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 同一检查点下仅将角色元素中的 0xFF 改为 0xFE，保留原指纹并重算归档校验和，观察整份材料校验失败。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-altered.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 2 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
review: archive validation failed: darksafe: invalid audit range: record 2 fingerprint mismatch
exit status 1
